marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Obesity in a bottle : Understanding Liquid calories & Nutrition

Public performance rights included."What type of beverage do you drink? The choices you make have the potential to greatly affect your health--for better or for worse. Filmed at a 'fun park' with a fast-paced, teen-friendly format, this video addresses how beverages are a factor in the obesity issue. A registered dietitian presents: the effects of beverages on weight gain, beverage size, the dangers of both regular and diet sodas, a comparison of sports and energy drinks, a nutritional breakdown of other popular beverages, the benefits of drinking water"
